# One deposit covering two customers, written with a bank split per customer
# so each portion carries its own memo and its own figure. That is what lets a
# payment block name one portion and not the other, and it is the shape where
# one transaction can end up carrying an unpost's mark for one document while
# still holding money that settled another.
customer "C-SHARE-A"
	name: "Alpha Share"
	currency: CAD

customer "C-SHARE-B"
	name: "Beta Share"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-SHARE-A"
	customer_id: "C-SHARE-A"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-05-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-05-01
		description: "Service A"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-05-02
		due: 2026-06-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-SHARE-A"
		accumulate: true

invoice "INV-SHARE-B"
	customer_id: "C-SHARE-B"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-05-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-05-01
		description: "Service B"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 120
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-05-02
		due: 2026-06-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "INV-SHARE-B"
		accumulate: true

2026-05-15 * "Deposit covering Alpha and Beta"
	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:Bank 100.00 CAD
		memo: "Portion for Alpha"
	Assets:Bank 120.00 CAD
		memo: "Portion for Beta"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -100.00 CAD
		memo: "Portion for Alpha"
	Assets:Accounts Receivable -120.00 CAD
		memo: "Portion for Beta"
